app.name: Olá! Learn Portuguese
app.description: Interactive European Portuguese course for English and Vietnamese speakers, with a pixel-art tutor.

errors.restWorks: The rest of the app works normally.
errors.offlineTitle: The lessons could not be loaded
errors.offlineText: It looks like there is no internet connection (or the local server is not running).

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.intro: Each lesson is like a chapter of a book: explanations, dialogues, vocabulary and exercises — all to learn European Portuguese.
lessons.empty: No units were found in lessons/curso.json.

lesson.label: Unit {unidad} · Lesson {n}
lesson.dialogueHelp: Tap an underlined word to see what it means. Press «?» and the tutor will explain the sentence.

defaultQuestion.ordenar: Put the words in order to make the sentence:

exercise.accentsHint: So close! Only the accents or the cedilla (ã, õ, ç, é, ê…) are different. In Portuguese they matter.
exercise.almost: Almost perfect! There is just a small difference: check letter by letter.
exercise.tapInOrder: Tap the words in the right order.

practice.title: Practice
practice.intro: Short rounds of exercises from the whole course. What you answer here also counts in its lesson.
practice.noAudio: I can't find any exercises with audio.

phrases.title: Phrases for speaking
phrases.intro: Useful European Portuguese phrases for everyday situations.
phrases.howTo: How to practise: read the translation, hide the Portuguese, say the phrase out loud and compare. The star saves it in your notebook.
phrases.empty: There are no phrases yet. They are added in phrases/frases.json.

notebook.title: Notebook
notebook.intro: Everything you have saved to learn. You will practise it in «Review».
notebook.summary: {total} in total · {nuevas} new · {pendientes} to review today
notebook.searchPlaceholder: Search in Portuguese or in your language
notebook.emptyHelp: Save words with the star ☆ in the lessons or in «Phrases».
notebook.addByHandHelp: Write the Portuguese word or phrase exactly as you saw it, and its meaning in your language.
notebook.dictionary: Dictionary: look up any word in the course
notebook.dictionaryLabel: In Portuguese or in your language

review.title: Review
review.intro: Look at the card, try to remember the answer and then rate how well you knew it. The better you know it, the later it comes back.
review.nothingYet: You have nothing in your notebook yet.
review.savePhrases: Save some phrases or words from the lessons.
review.shortcuts: Shortcuts: Space to see the answer · 1 2 3 4 to rate

account.title: Account
account.why: With an account, your progress and notebook are saved in the cloud and you can use them on other devices.
account.createdConfirm: Account created. We have sent you an email: click the link to confirm it and then sign in. Check your spam folder too.
account.recoverHelp: We will send you an email with a link to set a new password.
account.recoverSent: Email sent. If it does not arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder.
account.deleteCloudHelp: Deletes the copy saved in the cloud. What is in this browser is not touched.
account.deleteCloudConfirm: The copy of your progress saved in the cloud will be deleted and you will be signed out. The data in this browser is kept. Continue?
account.notConnected: Accounts are not connected yet: Supabase still has to be configured (see js/config.js and supabase/esquema.sql). You can see the forms, but they do not work yet.
account.notConnectedForm: Accounts are not connected to Supabase yet. Once it is configured, this form will work.

state.desactivada: Your progress is saved only in this browser.
state.sin-sesion: You are not signed in. Your progress is saved only in this browser.

error.passwordShort: The password must be at least 6 characters long.
error.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords do not match.

lessonsNotInCatalog.other: {n} lessons are not in the Supabase catalogue yet, so their progress stays only in this browser ({ids}). Run the catalogue SQL (npm run catalogo-sql).

error.cannotConnect: Could not connect to the account server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.offlineLocal: No connection to the server. Your progress is still being saved in this browser.

error.badEmail: The email does not look valid.
error.rateLimit: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a little and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Changes the language of menus and explanations. You always learn Portuguese, and your progress is kept.
settings.noVoice: There is no Portuguese voice installed on this device.

backup.title: Backup
backup.help: Download a file with all your progress and your notebook. When you load it, it is merged with what you already have: nothing is deleted.

reset.title: Reset
reset.help: Start again from scratch. If you are signed in, it is also reset in the cloud.
reset.confirm: Are you sure? The progress of the lessons and reviews will be deleted. Your notebook is kept (its cards become new again).
reset.confirmAll: Are you sure? The progress of the lessons, the reviews AND your whole notebook will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

help: I can't find a Portuguese voice on your device, so I can't read the Portuguese out loud for you. And I would do it so well!
On **Windows**: Settings → Time & language → Speech → Add voices → Português (Portugal). The **Edge** browser already includes very natural Portuguese voices.
On **Android**: Settings → System → Languages → Text-to-speech output → install the Portuguese voice data.
On **iPhone/iPad**: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices → Portuguese. On **Mac**: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content.

tutor.title: Your tutor
tutor.name: Tutor
touchFace: Hey! You're messing up my hair. Do you know how long this takes?
Poking my cheek so you don't have to study? Caught you.
Olá, olá! Yes, I'm still here. I'm not going anywhere.
Ouch! OK, I know I'm adorable. But Portuguese won't learn itself.
touchBody: This book is full of Portuguese. Well, and of my notes, which are the best.
Careful with the book! It has all our lessons.
Do you like my outfit? It's the traditional dress of Viana do Castelo, in the north of Portugal. The gold heart is a «coração de Viana».
touchTooMuch: OK, OK! That's enough! Let's study a little, shall we?
You'll leave me without a fringe! Focus on your Portuguese.
tutor.welcome: Olá! I'm your Portuguese tutor. Well, the best Portuguese tutor, but I don't like to brag. Choose a lesson and let's start.
tutor.welcomeBack: Olá{quien}! You're back. I knew you couldn't resist my lessons. Shall we continue?
tutor.lessonIntro: Let's go with «{titulo}»! Tap the underlined words to see what they mean and press the «?» stamp on each sentence so I can explain it.

exercisesLeft.one: Hey, hey! Not so fast: you still have 1 exercise left. Do it and then we can celebrate.
exercisesLeft.other: Hey, hey! Not so fast: you still have {n} exercises left. Do them and then we can celebrate.

tutor.lessonFinished: Lesson finished! {n} correct answers. I knew that with a tutor like me you'd make it. I'm proud of you.
tutor.literally: Word for word it would be something like: «{literal}».
tutor.pronounced: It sounds roughly like: **{pron}**. It's an approximation, not an exact transcription.
tutor.listenOnly: Text hidden. Press ▶ and listen. Use 🔊 on each sentence if you miss something. No cheating!
tutor.saved: Noted! «{texto}» is now in your notebook. We'll practise it in «Review».
tutor.alreadySaved: «{texto}» is already in your notebook. My memory is excellent!

notebookCount.one: You have {n} thing saved in your notebook. That's how I like it, all tidy!
notebookCount.other: You have {n} things saved in your notebook. That's how I like it, all tidy!

tutor.notebookEmpty: Your notebook is empty. When you see an interesting word, press the star and I'll save it here.
tutor.stuck: Oh! This one is giving you trouble, isn't it? Don't worry, that's what I'm here for.
praise: Correct! You can tell who your teacher is.
That's it! You're doing really well.
Perfect! I couldn't have said it better myself… well, maybe a tiny bit better.
tutor.practiceIntro: Here we train your ear with exercises from the whole course. Portuguese ears, here we go!

practiceMistakes.one: You have {n} exercise you got wrong. Shall we have a rematch? Or, if you prefer, we can train your ear.
practiceMistakes.other: You have {n} exercises you got wrong. Shall we have a rematch? Or, if you prefer, we can train your ear.

tutor.noMistakes: You don't have any mistakes to review! Either you haven't done any exercises yet… or you're a genius. I'd go with the second.
tutor.phrasesIntro: Here are phrases to get by in Portuguese from day one. Listen, repeat, and if you want a challenge, hide the Portuguese.
tutor.phrasesHidden: Portuguese hidden. Read the translation, say the phrase out loud and tap the blurred text to check.
tutor.reviewNothing: To review, I need material. Save words with the star ☆ and I'll wait for you here.
tutor.reviewAllDone: All up to date! Nothing else to review today. Enjoy it, you've earned it.

reviewWaiting.one: You have {n} card waiting for you. Shall we start? I'm ready, as always.
reviewWaiting.other: You have {n} cards waiting for you. Shall we start? I'm ready, as always.

reviewAgain: No problem, you'll see it again in a moment.
This one is stubborn… but I'm more stubborn!
Relax: making mistakes is also learning.
reviewEasy: Easy! You can tell who's teaching you.
Perfect! This one is yours now.

reviewFinished.one: Review finished! {n} card. Consistency is the key, and you have it. Well, and an excellent tutor.
reviewFinished.other: Review finished! {n} cards. Consistency is the key, and you have it. Well, and an excellent tutor.

tutor.profile: This is your profile. Tell me your name so I can congratulate you properly.
tutor.profileWithName: Here's your profile, {nombre}. Look at that progress… with a tutor like me, no surprise.
tutor.niceName: Muito prazer, {nombre}! A lovely name. Almost as lovely as mine.
tutor.noName: Fine, I'll keep not knowing your name. A mysterious choice.
tutor.signedIn: Signed in! I'm merging the progress in this browser with the one in the cloud.
tutor.signedOut: Signed out. Your progress is still saved in this browser.
tutor.accountCreated: Account created! Your progress is now saved in the cloud.
tutor.accountCreatedConfirm: Account created! Check your email to confirm it.
tutor.recoverSent: I've sent you an email. Click the link and come back here to set the new password.
tutor.passwordChanged: Password changed. This time, write it down somewhere safe!
tutor.setNewPassword: Almost done: write your new password.
tutor.cloudDeleted: Cloud data deleted and signed out.
tutor.formError: Oops, something went wrong. Look at the form message.
tutor.backupDownloaded: Backup downloaded. Keep it somewhere safe, like I keep my notes.
tutor.backupLoaded: Backup loaded! I've merged that progress with what you already had.
tutor.backupInvalid: That file doesn't look like a backup of this app. Look for one called «ola-portuguese-progress-…json».
tutor.resetDone: Done: we start from scratch. I remember everything, but I won't tell anyone.
tutor.notFound: Hmm… I can't find that. Are you sure it exists?
tutor.offline: I can't reach the lessons. Check the connection and try again.

validation.offline: No connection: {archivo} could not be read.
validation.courseMissing: The file lessons/curso.json with the list of units does not exist.
validation.unknownContent: There is something in the file that the app does not understand.
validation.jsonError: The file contains a format (JSON) error.
validation.missingComma: It looks like a comma is missing at the end of the previous line.
validation.endsEarly: It looks like the file ends too early: a closing brace } or bracket ] may be missing.
validation.curlyQuotes: Line {linea} has “curly” quotes (this happens when copying from Word). Texts must use straight quotes: "like this".
validation.trailingComma: Line {linea} has an extra comma: there cannot be a comma just before } or ].
validation.comment: Line {linea} has a comment with //. The JSON format does not allow comments.
validation.unknownField: {donde}: the field «{campo}» is not recognised and is ignored. Possible fields: {campos}.
validation.mustBeObject: {donde}: it must be written between braces { }.
validation.badId: {donde}: the identifier «{id}» is not valid (use lowercase letters, numbers, - and _).
validation.mustStartWithBrace: The file must start with { and end with }.
validation.missingBlocks: The «bloques» field (the list of blocks of the lesson) is missing or empty.
validation.idMismatch: The «id» field ({id}) does not match the file name ({archivo}); the file name is used.
validation.missingLessonTitle: The «titulo» field (title in Portuguese) is missing.
validation.missingSubtitle: The «subtitulo» field (title in English and Vietnamese) is missing.
validation.duplicateExerciseId: {donde}: the exercise id «{id}» is repeated in this lesson.
validation.exerciseWithoutId: {donde}: the exercise has no «id». Add one so the progress is kept if the text changes.
validation.wordsMustBeObject: The «palabras» field must be written between braces { } with one entry per word.
validation.badWord: {donde}: it must be a text or a group { } with «trad», «pron», etc.
validation.analysisPart: {donde}, analysis {n}: each part is written like this: ["word", "function"].
validation.analysisNotInSentence: {donde}, analysis {n}: «{texto}» does not appear in the sentence.
validation.missingPortugueseSentence: {donde}: the Portuguese sentence «pt» is missing. It is skipped.
validation.badRows: {donde}: «filas» must be a list of rows: [["eu", "sou"], ["tu", "és"]].
validation.unevenRows: {donde}: not all rows have the same number of cells.
validation.missingImageDescription: {donde}: the image «descripcion» is missing (it is read by people who cannot see it).
validation.missingAnswers: {donde}: the correct «respuestas» are missing (a list: ["Chamo-me Ana"]).
validation.missingOrderSentence: {donde}: the Portuguese «frase» to put in order is missing.
validation.orderNeedsTwoWords: {donde}: the «frase» needs at least two words.
validation.severalCorrect: {donde}: only one option can be marked as correct.
validation.missingCorrect: {donde}: the «correcta» field (the text of the correct option) is missing.
validation.correctNotFound: {donde}: the correct answer «{correcta}» does not match any option ({opciones}).
validation.missingGapSentence: {donde}: the «frase» with the gap (___) is missing.
validation.noGap: {donde}: the sentence has no gap. Write it with underscores: ___
validation.unknownType: {donde}: the type «{tipo}» does not exist. Possible types: {tipos}.
